- Initial release of the tax-prep-pre-file-audit-premortem skill.
- Provides a structured premortem framework for identifying and addressing audit risks in complex tax returns before filing.
- Includes clear activation triggers (e.g., aggressive/uncertain positions, client audit concerns) and situations when not to use.
- Details actionable steps: rating position authority, confirming substantiation, disclosure decisions, and client communication on audit risk.
- Adds example scenarios, compliance references, and review checklists for individual preparers and firm workflows.
